rules.note: Label says other drugs should be taken at least 1 hour before or 4 to 6 hours after cholestyramine, so cholestyramine is at least 4 hours before and 1 hour after other drugs. The 4-hour value is the lower bound of the stated 4 to 6 hour range.
Maximum recommended daily dose is 6 pouches or scoopfuls, stated as 24 grams of anhydrous cholestyramine resin.
